info.title: Parikshaa
info.description: Assessment with a tamper-evident ledger and a micro-viva engine. Institution routes use a shared staff bearer token; candidate routes use a short-lived token scoped to one attempt, which is why they address it as `me`.

get.description: Served from the same schemas the routes validate against, so it cannot drift from them.

post.description: Rejected with 422 and every problem at once if the exam is misconfigured.

post.description: A person's decision. Nothing in the system reaches this on its own — no verdict, no confidence, no combination of them. The reason is written into the ledger and shown to the candidate.

reason.description: Recorded in the ledger and shown to the candidate. A short reason is rejected.

get.summary: Stream the next micro-viva probe, if one is due
get.description: text/event-stream. Events: `token` while the probe is written, then `probe` with its id and prompt, or `none` when nothing qualifies — which is the ordinary case.

post.description: The body carries the reply and nothing else. How long it took is measured on the server, between the probe's recorded `askedAt` and this request arriving.

schema.description: The reply alone. Latency is measured on the server and is not accepted from a client.

requestBody.description: The reply alone. Latency is measured on the server and is not accepted from a client.
